'''Tank Buster droid''',<ref name="Tank Buster">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Tank Buster Droid|[[Makeb]]}}</ref> was a line of heavy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], which were widely utilized during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Three-legged droids were equipped with two long mounted cannons and two shorter ones, integrated in droids' arms.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Multiple models of Tunk Buster droids existed, utilized by various militarized groups, including Czerka itself. Known models included:
*[[IR-45 Eradicator droid]]<ref name="Shroud Quesh" />
*[[KR-82 Expulser|KR-82 Expulser droid]]<ref name="Kaon" />
*[[MX-51 Tasker droid]]<ref name="MX-51" />
*[[NS-55 Enforcer droid]]<ref name="NS-55">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Guardian NS-55 Enforcer Droid|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
*[[P-2B Assault droid]]<ref name="Scum">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=operation|Scum and Villainy}}</ref>
*[[SR-78 Bulwark Defense droid]]<ref name="Shroud Revealed">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=heroic|All The Pieces/The Shroud Revealed|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
*[[Phase X sovereign droid]]<ref name="Phase X">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Phase X Sovereign Droid|[[Quesh]]}}</ref>

==History==
[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] used Tank Buster droids in its activities on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]; such droids were among the forces defending [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|Czerka archeological facility]], build years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Thing Found" /> Decades later, the droids were still found in a vicinity of the base,<ref name="devision 7">{{TORcite|type=location|Czerka Archaeological Site on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> while broken down units could be found all across the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. Some of these droids were reprogrammed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], to be used against the remaining Czerka forces,<ref name="Czerka Sabotage" /> while some gone completely rogue, posing danger to those passing through the desert.<ref name="Malfunctioning Droid">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Malfunctioning Czerka Droid}}</ref>

Militias which used Tank Buster droids included those of [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Houses]] [[House Ulgo|Ulgo]]<ref name="Ulgo" /> and [[House Panteer|Panteer]]<ref name="Panteer" /> of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and criminal organizations such as the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]],<ref name="Cartel" /> [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]],<ref name="MX-51" /> [[Exchange]]<ref name="Exchange" /> and [[White Maw]].<ref name="White Maw" /> The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] used them on a number of planets, including [[Quesh]]<ref name="Phase X" /> and [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="Taris Rep" />

On [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle for the planet]], Tank Buster droids seen action on both sides, deployed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]],<ref name="Corellia Imp" /> [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]]<ref name="CorSec" /> and [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] militias.<ref name="Drall">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Drall Tank Droid|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>

[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Varad]] forces used Tank Buster droids in taking over [[Allusis]].<ref name="Mando" /> Another prominent owner of these droids was the [[The Shroud (Human)|Shroud]], who used them in protection of his various facilities; specifically [[IR-45 Eradicator Droid|IR-45]] on [[Quesh]]<ref name="Shroud Quesh" /> and [[SR-78 Bulwark Defense Droid|SR-78]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Shroud Revealed" />
